name: Security anomaly detected
verdict: Unrecognized device / anomalous outbound traffic detected, matching {attack_technique}. Isolated automatically.
customer_message: We caught and isolated a network security event automatically. Evidence has been logged for your records.

name: Premise hardware / power fault
citation: R3: wan_link=down AND ap_functional=false AND neighbor_relay_available=false
verdict: No upstream signal and no local recovery path. Likely hardware or power fault at the premise.
customer_message: This looks like it needs a technician. We've logged a service ticket — no need to call in.

name: Carrier outage, relayed via neighbor
verdict: Outage upstream of the premise. Status relayed to us through a nearby appliance — we already know.
customer_message: We can already see this outage — a neighboring unit relayed your status to us. No action needed, no truck roll.

name: Carrier-side outage, isolated
citation: R1: wan_link=down AND ap_functional=true AND neighbor_relay_available=false
verdict: Outage upstream of the premise. Box itself is healthy — nothing local to fix.
customer_message: We can already see this outage from our side — no action needed on your end. Crews are aware. No truck roll required.

name: Local config drift, safe to auto-remediate
verdict: Local DNS/DHCP fault detected. Safe to auto-remediate.
customer_message: We found a local network glitch and fixed it automatically. Give it about a minute.

name: Nominal
citation: R4: wan_link=up AND dns_ok=true AND dhcp_ok=true
